findings.title: Where the error lives
findings.read: Volume is the larger source of error (53.03 yds from volume vs 46.61 from rate). Fix the volume model first; tuning the other half cannot recover this.

findings.title: Volume bias
findings.read: We under-project attempts by 1.12 per player (projected 31.39, actual 32.52).

findings.title: Rate bias
findings.read: yards per attempt is over-projected by 0.14 (projected 7.18, actual 7.04).

findings.title: Opponent adjustment is costing accuracy
findings.read: Error with the adjustment 61.1, without it 61.02. Removing it would be more accurate on this sample.

findings.title: Against the closing line
findings.read: Beat the line on 56/143 (39.16%). Our MAE 60.2 vs the line's 55.51. The book is the better projection.
